ios.desc:
Mathy helps turn math you already understand into something you can do quickly and reliably. It is for anyone who knows a topic but still feels slow, rusty, or inconsistent with it.

Choose the topics you have learned, then start practicing in one tap. Mathy uses your past answers to choose what will help most next, gives immediate feedback, and brings problems back at useful times. You do not have to make flashcards or plan your own review schedule.

PRACTICE YOUR WAY

Choose a daily problem goal, practice for a set amount of time, or keep going without a limit. Mathy remembers your preference and keeps the next useful session easy to start.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS

Follow clear progress across your selected topics. Mathy shows what is becoming automatic, what is still building, and what could use attention.

PLAY FOR SPEED

Try the optional 60-Second Sprint, track your personal best, and build fluency without changing your learning schedule.

OFFLINE. NO ACCOUNT.

Practice works offline and without an account. Your learning history stays on your device unless you turn on free iCloud sync in Settings. With iOS 17 or later, you can keep your progress together on iPhone and iPad using the same Apple Account.

Mathy is for practicing knowledge you have already studied. It does not replace math instruction.
